title: Figure 3: Differential resistance dV/dI of a mechanical point contact vs current
description: Plot captioned 'Figure 3. Differential Resistance dV/dI of a Mechanical Point Contact as a Function of Current for a Series of Magnetic Fields', with dV/dI (38-45 ohms) versus V (-0.03 to 0.03 V) and multiple field-labeled peaks. An inset plots threshold voltage against applied field mu0H (T), showing a linear increase (Reference 5). It accompanies section '3. Spin-Transfer-Torque / 3.1 STT Basics'.
